strict_four: Sensitivity scenario; the nonenal threshold is external and only one measured beer passes. Never report this as a universal style feasibility standard.
sample_law: P_style(X | specified ceilings); exact four/two-dimensional marginal rejection plus conditional Gaussian for other coordinates
validation: Post-diagnostic internal three-fold evaluation, no independent new beer data. Fit maps and covariances on training folds only. Conditional-law quality must be evaluated against feasible held-out real beers, not mixed with unconditional-law scores.
sensory: Frozen six-model full-data predictions are descriptive, not independent tasting validation.
